# GPU.js (vendored)

Vendored GPU.js, used by CrysViz for browser-side GPU-accelerated calculations.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/gpujs/gpu.js
- Project site: http://gpu.rocks/
- License: **MIT** (GPU.js upstream license).

## Files
- `gpu-browser.js` — vendored GPU.js (browser build).
- `gpu-esm.js`, `marching_cubes.js` — local adapter/helper files.
